title: Agents cannot skip git hooks or force-push without lease, and commits run biome on staged files
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-19, standards enforcement audit after #1521 (operator: close every standards gap for good). Evidence: r-biome-clean says fast runs before every commit, but core.hooksPath is empty and .git/hooks holds samples only; lanes.md forbids --no-verify, HUSKY=0 and a changed core.hooksPath, and lead-rules.md:45 requires --force-with-lease, yet no Bash guard refuses them (scripts/claude/bash-guards.ts).
Files: scripts/claude/bash-guards.ts, test/claude/bash-guards.test.ts
Outcome: The agent Bash guard refuses git commit/push with --no-verify, HUSKY=0, git config core.hooksPath, and git push --force/-f without --force-with-lease, with exit 2 and the rule named; a tracked pre-commit hook (installed by krn lane start into each worktree) runs biome check on staged files.
Proof: node --test test/claude/bash-guards.test.ts: pass with one refused case per form and one allowed --force-with-lease.
